REMOVED FROM UD JURY CALENDAR SET FOR SEP-12-2016 - PER COURT ORDER THIS MATTER IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF'S COUNSEL (LIANA AYRAPERYAN) REPRESENTED TO THE COURT THAT THE PLAINTIFF'S REPRESENTATIVE WAS PRESENT AND ASKED IF SHE SHOULD GO OUTSIDE TO GET THE REPRESENTATIVE. THE COURT SAID NO, JUST GO TO DEPARTMENT 620 WITH JUDGE PRO TEM DERISH. SHORTLY AFTER, THE DEFENSE ATTORNEY (KIMBERLY SHINDEL) REAPPEARED IN DEPARTMENT 501 TO REPORT THAT THE PLAINTIFF'S REPRESENTATIVE, YET AGAIN, HAD NOT APPEARED. AT APPROXIMATELY 9:51AM, THE REPRESENTATIVE APPEARED OUTSIDE OF DEPARTMENT 501. IT WASN'T UNTIL THE COURT ASKED WHERE THE REPRESENTATIVE WAS THE PLAINTIFF'S COUNSEL AGAIN REPRESENTED THAT HE WAS OUTSIDE AND WENT TO GO GET HIM. THIS TIME THE REPRESENTATIVE (JOHN RYAN) APPEARED. AFTER HEARING FROM BOTH SIDES, THE COURT DISMISSED THE MATTER WITH PREJUDICE. (AJR/501)
